name: Contract review
goal: Find the clauses that break our policy before the contract goes to legal, not after.

assistant.greeting: Hi, I can help you get this contract ready to sign. Ask me about any clause or our contract policy.

answers.reply: Our policy caps the other party's liability at no less than the total contract value. A lower cap, or none for data breaches, is flagged for legal.
Contracts that renew by themselves need at least 60 days' notice to end. If the notice period is shorter, or missing, the check flags it.
We need the right to end the contract for convenience with 30 days' notice. Contracts that only allow ending for breach are flagged.
Suppliers need public liability of at least $20 million and professional indemnity of at least $5 million, current for the whole term.
Our standard payment terms are 30 days from a correct invoice. Anything shorter needs the finance manager's sign-off.

assistant.fallback: In the real app I'd answer that from the contract policy. For now, try asking about liability, renewals, termination, insurance or payment terms.

steps.label: About the contract
steps.goal: Tell us what the contract is for and who it's with, so we know which policies apply.

fields.label: Other party
fields.hint: The legal name, as on their ABN

fields.label: Total value ($)
fields.hint: Over the whole term, excluding GST

sample.Contract title: Office cleaning services, Sydney and Melbourne

steps.label: The contract
steps.goal: Add the contract and its schedules. Each one is checked as you add it.

checklist.name: Contract
checklist.check: The final draft, with every schedule it refers to attached
checklist.sample: Clause 8 refers to Schedule 3 (pricing), but it isn't attached

checklist.name: Statement of work
checklist.check: Services, sites and service levels match the contract
checklist.sample: The statement of work lists 4 sites; the contract lists 3

checklist.name: Certificate of insurance
checklist.check: Public liability of $20 million or more, current for the whole term
checklist.sample: The certificate expires on 30 June 2027, well before the contract ends

checklist.name: Pricing schedule
checklist.check: Adds up to the total value in the contract details
checklist.sample: The pricing schedule adds up to $512,000, not $486,000

steps.label: Policy check
steps.goal: Here's every clause that doesn't meet our policy, in plain words, with the wording we'd suggest instead.

steps.label: Sign-off
steps.goal: Legal and finance see the contract with the policy check done, and approve it to sign.

config.confirmText: The business owner will take your note back to the other party. Say which clauses still need to change.
